title: Master Switch
doc: One key. Off runs the game unmodified without removing the plugin; check
it first when the mod appears to do nothing.
Plugin.Load binds every key (Slices.Init) and then returns on this
switch before any subsystem initialises, so off patches nothing while
the [Slices] lines are still written. A value that cannot be read is
not treated as off: the bind error is logged and the mod runs.
uiDoc: The master switch for the whole mod.
Off runs the game unmodified, with the plugin still installed. Nothing on any other page has any effect while this is off, whatever that page is set to.

fields.label: Enable CKF Hard Mode
fields.doc: Turn off to run the game unmodified without removing the plugin.
